pages.text: A CONSTANT line makes a constant: a named value that never changes.$(br2)It looks like a VARIABLE line, but it must have a value. You can't ASSIGN to a constant, and it can't receive a CALL result.
Craft a type base and three bones, or turn a VARIABLE block into a CONSTANT block.
$(1)CONSTANT BASE INTEGER 42$(br)CONSTANT ORIGIN STRUCT point$(br)BEGIN$(br)  x 3$(br)END CONSTANT$()
